notes: The person's citation (2Kgs.2.11, Elijah's ascension) doesn't contain this root at all -- that verse's verb is H5927 (עלה, the standard "go up"), a different, very common root. The only actual attestation of H5266 is Ps.139.8 (אֶסַּק שָׁמַיִם, "if I ascend up into heaven"), which matches the gloss "ascend" exactly -- shipped with the corrected citation.
